_note: Hand-written cases for core/reading/decide.decide_finish (the finish as evidence). NOT produced by running the code. Default threshold: sure 0.9. Another program that decides the same way - the Android app - must pass this file too. `net` is the foil network's probability of a foil (null: not asked); `symbol` is what the OCR read in the set line ('foil', 'non-foil', 'unknown'). A threshold is given as {"sure": x} when a case needs another.

cases.name: a printing that exists in foil only is certain
etched counts as a foil finish
foil and etched only is a foil
a printing that exists non-foil only is certain
a symbol the OCR read as a star stands over the network
a symbol the OCR read as a dot stands over the network
no symbol, a network that is sure of a foil
no symbol, a network that is sure of a regular card
boundary: a probability equal to sure is believed as a foil
boundary: 0.1 is NOT sure of a regular card, because 1 - 0.9 is 0.09999999999999998 in floating point
boundary: 0.09 is sure of a regular card
a network that is not sure either way
an unread marker is unknown, not regular
no finishes known and nothing read
no finishes known, the symbol still counts
another threshold is used when given
another threshold, the regular side starts at 1 - sure = 0.25
another threshold: 0.3 is between 0.25 and 0.75, not sure either way
an unrecognised symbol is not a symbol
